id: title:jonathanlab:move pi auto publish into an extension

review.posthog_relevance: Adds typed extension support and an auto-publish extension to the Pi agent, potentially streamlining PostHog contribution workflows.
review.reason: The change introduces a new typed extension system and an auto-publish extension. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H3 establish the runtime extension types and configuration, while P1.F3.H3 provides the instantiation. P1.F8.H1 adds a specific auto-publish extension with a system prompt to automate PR creation. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement. However, the connection
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the auto-publish extension actually being adopted and successfully executing the described workflow, which is not demonstrated by the implementation alone.

observations.behavior: Adds PiRuntimeExtension type and PiRpcBootstrap.extensions field; P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines the typed extension set for the Pi agent; P1.F2.H2 adds the extensions field to the bootstrap interface.

observations.behavior: Replaces channelMode with extensions in PiRpcClient and PiRpcHost; P1.F2.H3 and P1.F3.H4.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the configuration and bootstrap to use extensions instead of channelMode, establishing the new extension selection mechanism.

observations.behavior: Adds extensionFactories and runtimeExtensions to instantiate repository-tools and auto-publish; P1.F3.H3 and P1.F3.H4.
observations.posthog_connection: Instantiates the auto-publish extension and repository-tools extension, supplying them to the harness runtime.

observations.behavior: Adds a new auto-publish extension that injects a system prompt into the coding agent, instructing it to create a posthog branch, stage changes, use git_signed_commit, and open a draft PR without using git commit or push.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support PostHog's desktop agent workflow by automating the creation of PRs for PostHog-related work, potentially streamlining contributions or internal development workflows.
